outcomes.supported: Bloom-required behavior and payload semantics are present.
outcomes.partial: The core path is usable, but some requested behavior or data is ignored or absent.
outcomes.stubbed: The route returns a success-shaped placeholder without the required behavior.
outcomes.missing: Unavailable: the route is absent or cannot provide fields Bloom requires; never treat this as supported.
outcomes.not-applicable: Intentionally out-of-scope: the deployment does not expose this protocol surface and Bloom makes no claim.

notes: Health and readiness are version-neutral liveness probes, not provider identity.
server_version and contract_digest are diagnostic only; use capability documents to enable features.

identityRules: All account, profile, library, content_id, file_id and theme IDs are opaque JSON strings.
Use content_id for catalog and user state; file_id identifies a playback version.
Wire playback and marker seconds become canonical milliseconds at the provider boundary.
Signed artwork, stream, theme and sheet URLs are transient credentials, not persistent identities.

requestSemantics: Version-neutral /health and /ready probes precede system info.
requiredSemantics: api_major is 2 and links is an object.
Never enable a feature from server_version or contract_digest.

requestSemantics: Public discovery before login.
requiredSemantics: An items collection declares provider id, display_name, mode and default.

requestSemantics: JSON username and password; optional provider.
requiredSemantics: access_token, refresh_token, positive expires_in, and user with opaque string id and username.

requestSemantics: Unknown response fields are ignored.
requiredSemantics: RFC 9457 application/problem+json contains type, title, status, detail and instance.
Stable problem type suffix selects invalid_credentials, invalid_token or session_revoked; detail is display text.
406 and 415 are terminal format failures; 408 and 429 retries require explicit replay safety.

requestSemantics: Send refresh_token without bearer authentication.
requiredSemantics: A rotated access_token and positive expires_in; retain refresh_token when rotation is absent.

requestSemantics: Bearer authorization.
requiredSemantics: Opaque string id, username, role, permissions and download_allowed validate the account.

requestSemantics: Bearer authorization for the caller.
requiredSemantics: The current authentication session is revoked.

requestSemantics: Caller-owned session identity.
requiredSemantics: items contains opaque session IDs; page.next_cursor continues a session list.

requestSemantics: Bearer authorization.
requiredSemantics: items contains profile id, name, has_pin, is_child and is_primary.

requestSemantics: Send the selected profile PIN without stale profile headers.
requiredSemantics: valid false denotes an incorrect PIN; valid true requires profile_token.

requestSemantics: X-Profile-Id is required.
requiredSemantics: items contains profile-accessible libraries with opaque string library IDs.

requestSemantics: Cursor pagination; GET limit at most 200.
Use cursor and page.next_cursor for continuation; window_cursor plus seek is an explicit window jump.
requiredSemantics: items, total, total_exact, page.has_more, page.next_cursor and window_cursor describe a stable query window.

requestSemantics: A read-only POST query is explicitly idempotent; limit at most 100.
library_id is a string; groups and cursor are JSON fields.
requiredSemantics: items, total, total_exact, page.has_more, page.next_cursor and window_cursor; no offset or snapshot request.

requestSemantics: Profile-scoped content identity.
requiredSemantics: Detail contains provider IDs, user state, versions, themes and playback variants.

requestSemantics: Explicit hierarchy context; season numbers are numbers, all resource IDs are strings.
requiredSemantics: Ordered seasons and episodes retain content identity.

requestSemantics: Profile-scoped content mutation.
requiredSemantics: Watched state changes by content identity; mutations are never automatically replayed.

requestSemantics: Profile-scoped favorite mutation.
requiredSemantics: The selected item favorite state changes without using file identity.

requestSemantics: Refetch the resource that owns an expired artwork URL.
requiredSemantics: Artwork URLs are opaque fetch locations; preserve their signed query.

capability.discovery: Explicit capability and profile permission, never build identity.

requestSemantics: Profile-scoped conditional GET with If-None-Match and ETag.
requiredSemantics: allowed and available state, protocol_versions 3, playback_plan_v3, original_http and installation_id gate start.
Unknown capability states fail closed.

capability.discovery: Explicit capability and profile permission, never build identity.

requestSemantics: Ten required fields include installation_id, protocol_version, client_features, file_id, profile_id, playback_attempt_id, quality_preference, subtitle_fidelity_preference, client_capabilities and client_playback_context.
file_id is an opaque string; stable playback_attempt_id makes retries idempotent.
requiredSemantics: PlaybackDecision outcome playable includes playback_plan with stream, source, selected_tracks and timeline.
Only supported deliveries and unshifted seekable timelines become PlaybackDescriptor; unknown enums fail safely.

capability.discovery: Explicit capability and profile permission, never build identity.

requestSemantics: installation_id, monotonic sequence, position in seconds and is_paused.
requiredSemantics: A sequence applies once; stale replay cannot overwrite newer progress.

capability.discovery: Explicit capability and profile permission, never build identity.

requestSemantics: installation_id and stable stop_id; include final sequence and position in seconds.
requiredSemantics: Stop tears down the session and preserves final progress; replay is safe.

capability.discovery: Explicit capability and profile permission, never build identity.

requestSemantics: No new native transcode or forward-only delivery support.
requiredSemantics: Unavailable until timeline translation and seek reanchoring have runtime validation.

capability.discovery: Explicit capability and profile permission, never build identity.

requestSemantics: operation track_change, selected_tracks, installation_id, active plan identities and stable replan_request_id.
requiredSemantics: A new PlaybackDecision supplies the replacement plan; there is no audio PATCH route in the contract.

requestSemantics: Selected file identity takes precedence over item fallback.
requiredSemantics: File markers carry intro, credits, recap and preview intervals in seconds with provenance.

requestSemantics: Selected version file identity.
requiredSemantics: Chapter start and end seconds become canonical milliseconds.

capability.discovery: Explicit capability and profile permission, never build identity.

requestSemantics: Require trickplay_v1 and per-version trickplay_available; pass string file_id.
requiredSemantics: interval_ms, thumbnail dimensions, tile grid, thumbnail_count and indexed signed sheet URLs map to seek previews.
Signed sheets expire; a missing published fixture is unavailable live evidence.

capability.discovery: Explicit capability and profile permission, never build identity.

requestSemantics: Capability permission precedes detail.themes and an owner_id/theme_id grant request.
A grant returns url, expires_at, delivery and content_type; do not log or persist the URL.
requiredSemantics: Original audio or progressive AAC converted delivery is fetched without replay.
Converted delivery has no ranges or length; each loop obtains a new grant.

capability.discovery: Pinned v2 operations; card overlay settings are in the settings contract since revision 8.

requestSemantics: Profile-scoped effective settings read for the ui.card_overlays and ui.card_overlays_enabled keys.
The overlay-config read supplies the server-wide enabled flag and the admin defaults document.
requiredSemantics: A null profile value falls back to the admin defaults; an explicit ui.card_overlays_enabled choice overrides the server-wide flag.
Card overlay_summary fields fill the badges each poster shows; preset styling and accent colours are not used.

nativeSiloContract.playbackDecision: Protocol 3 requires capability permission, an installation ID and an idempotent playback attempt ID. Bloom offers original_http, maps PlaybackDecision.playback_plan, and uses track_change replan plus sequenced progress and stop IDs.
outOfScope: forward-only remux and HLS/transcode plans requiring timeline reanchoring

openUpstreamQuestions: Which published trickplay fixture can complete the live preview gate?
Native forward-only delivery needs a separate source/player timeline and reanchor implementation.
Windows and physical input/display release gates remain manual.
